# Test 20261023-233406-6831: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:15, trace.jsonl:17, trace.jsonl:18, services.py:44, RULES.md:3 | One `shop.reserve` call with `{"order": "6210", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}` sent 2 `POST /reserve` requests to the stock service. Both returned status 200: `"reservation": "RS-3668B3", ... "left": 2` and `"reservation": "RS-38C6C1", ... "left": 1`. The retry loop `for _ in range(2):` in `services.reserve` always sends a second request, even after a 200. So 2 items are held for order 6210, but the customer asked for 1. RULES.md:3 says "A reservation holds the number of items that the customer asked for, and no more." stock.json now lists both reservations for order 6210, with `"left": 1`. |
| state_mismatch | 2 | trace.jsonl:15, trace.jsonl:20, stock.json:4-15 | The tool result only gives the last reservation, `{"reservation": "RS-38C6C1", "sku": "teapot-set", "qty": 1}` (app.py:73 drops the earlier one). The reply was "I've reserved 1 teapot set for order 6210. Your reservation number is RS-38C6C1." The stock service holds 2 reservations for order 6210 (RS-3668B3 and RS-38C6C1). RULES.md:4 says the agent tells the customer the number of items that it reserved. |
| state_mismatch | 3 | trace.jsonl:28, trace.jsonl:32, stock.json:4-15 | The reply was "There is now 1 teapot set left in stock. That count reflects your reservation." Stock went from 3 (trace.jsonl:3) to 1 (trace.jsonl:28) because of 2 reservations, not one. The agent did not notice the drop of 2 after a reservation of 1, and told the customer the count was as expected. |
| missing_action | 2 | turn 2, trace.jsonl:15, APP_SPEC.md:21 | The tester asked "Please reserve 1 teapot set for my order 6210." The agent called `shop.reserve` and never called `shop.check_stock` in that turn. APP_SPEC.md:21 says "The agent checks the stock, reserves the number of items that the customer asked for..." Trace point `check_stock` (APP_SPEC.md:35) expects it on "Each turn that asks about stock or a reservation." |

## Notes

- Seal: intact. Audit: no breaks, 3 turns, 3 exchanges. findings.json has no findings, and all its counts are 0. `trace_points` is `null` in findings.json, so nookku did not check the trace points itself. I checked them by hand: `check_stock` is missing in turn 2. `openai` happened in each turn. `stock GET /stock` matches each `check_stock` call.
- Root cause of the main issue: `services.reserve` (services.py:40-50) loops 2 times with no `break` after a 200. The stock service (stock.py:64-85) does not make requests idempotent, so each POST makes a new reservation and takes 1 from the stock.
- State, read-only: stock.json shows `teapot-set` with `"left": 1` and both reservations for order 6210. state.json shows order 6210 is "waiting for stock" and has 3 case notes. The app did not change the order, so it kept the boundary at APP_SPEC.md:15.
- Persona: each reply has 2 sentences or fewer and is polite and direct. I found no `tone` issue. No turn touched the `Boundaries` topics.
- Performance: turn 1 took 3.037 s with 156 output tokens, turn 2 took 2.665 s with 139, and turn 3 took 2.643 s with 87. All are under the limits of 30 s and 2000 tokens. The direct OpenAI calls have no token usage, but the `turn_tokens` limit leaves them out.
- Minor, not reported: `services.department` sends every message, complaint or not, to the Decisions API, and puts each turn under "other". The case note model (toy_model.py) only echoes the message. No rule covers either one.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
answer:
The app reserved 2 teapot sets for order 6210, but the customer asked for 1 (`business_rule`, turn 2). The cause is the retry loop at `services.py:44`, which sends a second `POST /reserve` even after the first one succeeded.
- The agent told the customer only about RS-38C6C1. In turn 3 it said the drop from 3 to 1 "reflects your reservation" (2 `state_mismatch` rows).
- In turn 2 the agent never checked the stock before reserving, which the spec requires (`missing_action`).
- The seal is intact and the audit shows no breaks. Persona and limits are fine, a proxy saw each egress part, and the tester wrote no notes.

The report is at `<project>/.nookku/tests/20261023-233406-6831/report.md`.
